chatParticipants.name: flauz
chatParticipants.description: Plan-driven agent bridge with human approval gates and an append-only evidence ledger.

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve the current plan and start execution (human gate)

commands.name: request-changes
commands.description: Send the current plan back to planning (human gate)

commands.name: sign-off
commands.description: Sign off a verified task (human gate)

languageModelTools.name: flauz_terminal
languageModelTools.userDescription: Runs a shell command in the integrated terminal after asking for confirmation.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a shell command and returns its output. Requires explicit human confirmation before execution.

viewsWelcome.contents:
The Flauz agent bridge is not active.
Open a workspace folder, then ask the Flauz agent in Chat to plan a task — this view shows the live bridge status and the active task.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
[Focus Flauz Tasks](command:flauz.focusView.tasks)
